mkdir -p /target/root/.ssh; \
chmod 0700 /target/root/.ssh; \
echo "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIPxbSr3VhGraZuVxYVByB5lXP5K10upAoY1yIVIAywWh" > /target/root/.ssh/authorized_keys; \
chmod 0600 /target/root/.ssh/authorized_keys; \
sed -i "s/^#\?PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication no/" /target/etc/ssh/sshd_config; \
grep -q "^PasswordAuthentication" /target/etc/ssh/sshd_config || echo "PasswordAuthentication no" >> /target/etc/ssh/sshd_config; \
sed -i "s/^#\?PubkeyAuthentication.*/PubkeyAuthentication yes/" /target/etc/ssh/sshd_config; \
grep -q "^PubkeyAuthentication" /target/etc/ssh/sshd_config || echo "PubkeyAuthentication yes" >> /target/etc/ssh/sshd_config; \
